name: lcc
description: Compacts a document or transcript down to only the blocks that matter for a stated goal, keeping kept text byte for byte instead of summarizing it.

interface.longDescription: Paste a long document, transcript, or tool log and state a goal. This plugin scores each block against that goal and returns only the relevant ones, verbatim, plus a report naming every block it dropped. Nothing is summarized or paraphrased, so kept content stays quotable and auditable.
defaultPrompt: Here's a long support transcript. Cut it down to just the part about refund delays.
This meeting transcript is 20 pages. Keep only what decides the launch date.
Trim this server log to the lines that explain the 500s.
